media.title: Images & videos
media.lede: Every photo and video on the website lives here. Upload it once, then pick it for a location, a class, a coach or the homepage.
media.uploadHint: Drop images or videos here, or choose files. Large photos are resized automatically.
media.uploaded: Uploaded. Add a short description so everyone knows what it shows.
media.limits: Images up to 6 MB, videos up to 40 MB. For longer videos, add a link instead.
media.linkHint: For long videos already on a CDN or video host. The link must start with https://
media.empty: No images or videos yet. Upload the first one.
media.descriptionHint: A few words on what the picture shows. Read aloud to people who can't see it.
media.focusHint: Click the part that must always stay in view when the picture is cropped.
media.inUse: It's in use, so it can't be deleted. Replace it where it's used first.
media.pickerEmpty: Nothing here yet. Upload a file to start.
